nodes.label: Poppy Career Counseling App
nodes.rationale: FastAPI+Next.js stack chosen for async SSE streaming and rapid prototyping; Ollama/Gemma 2B for fully local AI with no API costs; in-memory session dict (no DB) for MVP simplicity; Shadcn/ui + Tailwind for fast, accessible UI; Framer Motion for polished STEP transitions; Indian education system as core domain constraint.

nodes.label: Prompt Chaining Architecture
nodes.rationale: Five-step prompt chain (system, vibe, profile, chat, report) chosen to progressively narrow context — each step enriches the next with structured data while keeping individual prompts focused and within token budget for Gemma 2B.
